typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	sFilename as string (),
	tblEndurCommoditiesTradeEventsMaturedStaging_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		event_date as string,
		deal_tracking_num as string,
		toolset as string,
		ins_type as string,
		name as string,
		short_name as string,
		internal_external as string,
		type_of_event as string,
		trader_name as string,
		executed_by as string,
		marketer_name as string,
		trade_event_category as string,
		action_interval_days as string,
		tran_num as string,
		reference as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> DailyTradeEventsReportMatured	source(output(
		filename as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> checkarchivetabletopreventdupesLKPTABLE
DailyTradeEventsReportMatured derive(FileName = toString($sFilename),
		LoadDate_drv = toString(currentTimestamp())) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of trader_name} = trader_name) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion,checkarchivetabletopreventdupesLKPTABLE lookup(DerivedColumn@FileName == checkarchivetabletopreventdupesLKPTABLE@filename,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> checkarchivetabletopreventdupes
checkarchivetabletopreventdupes filter(!isMatch()) ~> checkarchivetabletopreventdupes0
checkarchivetabletopreventdupes0 sink(input(
		toolset as string,
		Internal_External as string,
		Action_Interval_Days as integer,
		EventDate as string,
		Reference as string,
		FileName as string,
		File_LoadDate as string,
		Marketer_Name as string,
		Executed_by as string,
		Name as string,
		Deal_Tracking_Num as string,
		Type_of_Event as string,
		insType as string,
		Short_Name as string,
		Trade_Event_Category as string,
		Trader_Name as string,
		tran_num as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		toolset,
		Internal_External = internal_external,
		Action_Interval_Days = action_interval_days,
		EventDate = event_date,
		Reference = reference,
		FileName,
		File_LoadDate = LoadDate_drv,
		Marketer_Name = marketer_name,
		Executed_by = executed_by,
		Name = name,
		Deal_Tracking_Num = deal_tracking_num,
		Type_of_Event = type_of_event,
		insType = ins_type,
		Short_Name = short_name,
		Trade_Event_Category = trade_event_category,
		Trader_Name = trader_name,
		tran_num),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblEndurCommoditiesTradeEventsMaturedStaging_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblEndurCommoditiesTradeEventsMaturedStaging
